description: Bus stops is a series of datasets listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Melbourne. This data set shows the locations of the bus stops within the city of Melbourne, As the city of Melbourne do not run the bus services, this is simply to show the locations of the stops, this data does not include the services that run from each of the stops. Coverage: City of Melbourne. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher City of Melbourne. Its tags are accessibility, bus-stops, eventsplanner, signs. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, JSON, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other open licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
